programs.description: Stepbrothers Vijayan and Madhavankutty constantly quarrel with each other but try to set their differences aside for a kabaddi tournament held in the memory of their father.
Mohanakrishnan is a fashion photographer and his brother's ghost haunts him. He had died after being bitten by a snake, leaving behind a young wife.
Three young men plot to rob a busy bank during its working hours. However, their plans go haywire after someone gets murdered in the bank premises, and they are accused of the crime.
Best friends Neelima and Aisha, who study in the same college, befriend fellow students Karthik and Kunjumon. Later, Neelima falls in love with Karthik and helps him through Aisha discreetly.
A young couple, Mukundan and Parvathi, along with their little daughter deals with various day-to-day problems in a comical way.
Sreenivasan, a simple villager, is passionate about local theatre and hanging out with his friends. His life takes a turn when he applies for a job in the police department.
Distinguished artists and musicians present enchanting performances interpreting the rich culture of India during the 2025 edition of the Soorya Festival.
An unemployed man living in Germany receives an opportunity to organise a star-studded event in Kerala. However, chaos ensues when he arrives in the country.
Zachariah and Balu remain best friends even after their marriage. However, things take a turn when their wives start fighting with each other.
Kunjoonjamma is an elderly woman who lives alone in a village. Her life changes when a girl named Girly claims that she is her granddaughter and comes to live with her.
After an elephant saves him from an accident in childhood, Krishna becomes fond of elephants. His life changes when he decides to adopt Arjunan, a severely injured elephant.
Daniel's grandfather, who is a strict patriarch, has the final say in every decision involving his family. However, things take a turn when he decides to make Daniel a priest.
Keshava Menon and Madhavan Nair are best friends and business partners. When Keshava dies in an accident, his son Balan takes over the company and realises Madhavan's ulterior motives.
Kavitha, a struggling woman, goes through a difficult time while repaying her brother's debts. Later, she takes up an acting job for a commercial and things change drastically.
Unni, who has a feminine voice, gets insulted by everyone in his neighbourhood. His life takes a turn when he gets married to a rich girl who is speech-impaired.
Josy is an unemployed young man who never acts responsibly. His life changes when his beloved mother dies in a fatal accident and his long-lost father returns home.
Nandagopan, a poor villager, writes a script and wants the famous actor Sooryakiran to help him with the film. Sooryakiran rejects him, but he is moved when he takes a deeper look at the script.
Ravishankar, a street urchin, is looked after by Salim, a local don. After Salim's demise, Ravishankar rises to power and fights against an evil gangster.
Jayaraman, a liftman and caretaker, relies on his non-visual senses and martial arts expertise to protect a little girl from a vengeful ex-con who is out to settle an old score.
Prince, a dog trainer, faces an awkward situation when his pet dog Diana acts in a film alongside his former lover, an actress who shares the same name as the dog.
